name: cui_a
prompt:
A sheet of 9 separate game interface panels on a fully transparent background, in a 3 by 3 grid, each panel a landscape rectangle about 3 wide by 2 high, centred in its own cell with wide empty transparent gaps between them. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels.

Image 1 is a style reference only: match its palette, materials, wear and rendering, and draw none of the objects in it. Unlike image 1, every asset here is drawn flat and face on (or straight down for floor), with no perspective.

Style: 1970s-80s "used future" industrial equipment inside one small crew capsule of a space station, owned by an indifferent corporation. The capsule is one operator's work station and living quarters, so every machine is compact and kept. Painted metal in dull, muted dark yellow, mustard yellow and burnt orange over grey and black steel, occasional yellow-black hazard stripes, visible bolts and rivets, scuffs, worn edges, chipped paint — lived in and kept: no grime, no rust, no oil stains, no soot. Glass is reinforced with a blue-green tint. Off-white parts are worn plastic. Colours dull and desaturated. Crisp game-asset rendering, lighting from the top left.

Each panel is the flat, face-on front housing of one machine, used as the background of that machine's control window. Every panel has the same layout: a sturdy outer frame about a twelfth of the panel's width, in that machine's own paint and materials, bolted at the corners; a band along the top about a fifth of the panel's height, holding only a blank riveted nameplate at its left; and below it one large plain flat recessed face of dark grey steel, empty and clean. The panels differ only in paint, material, light wear, rivet patterns and occasional hazard stripes on the frame. Draw NO controls of any kind: no buttons, no dials, no gauges, no switches, no levers, no knobs, no valves, no wheels, no lamps, no screens, no sight glasses, no pictograms, no meters. Red appears nowhere.

Panels in reading order (row 1 left to right, then row 2, then row 3):
1. Life support unit — grey steel with orange frame.
2. Workbench — dark yellow frame.
3. Moisture condenser — grey frame with yellow trim.
4. Solar strip — black frame with yellow corners.
5. Algae jar — grey frame.
6. Sprout tray — olive frame.
7. Mess table — mustard frame.
8. Washbasin — off-white ceramic-coloured frame edged in steel.
9. Toilet — grey frame with mustard trim.
